slides.tease: **400 good mornings later.** The cat has left the group three times.

slides.name: The Dog
slides.title: BEST CHAT EVER MADE
slides.body: Someone posts the sunrise every day at 6AM. I reply first every time. We are all so proud of the sun.

slides.name: The Goldfish
slides.meta: Not sure which group this is
slides.title: Wait, whose wedding
slides.body: Joined for the wedding photos. Forgot whose wedding. Congratulated a stranger with 40 heart emojis. Lovely ceremony though.

slides.name: The Owl
slides.title: Riddled with misinformation
slides.body: Forwarded as received. No. It should not have been received the first time. The owl has questions. The uncle has 40 more forwards.

slides.name: The Pigeon
slides.title: Finally, an audience
slides.body: Posted one photo of myself on a wire. Twelve thumbs up from relatives I have never met. This is what fame feels like.

slides.name: The Cat
slides.title: Escape attempt no. 3
slides.body: Left the group at dawn. They added me back before breakfast. This review is being written from inside the group.
Tag the cousin who only replies in thumbs up.
